propositions: The plan-writing guide lacks documentation of the 15 registered coaching moves despite authors being coached via those moves during Pass-4 review.

Field frequency analysis shows five high-frequency moves (specification-by-example 150, plan-the-verification 96, riskiest-assumption-test 51, state-attestation-evidence 41, propagate-to-children 22) that warrant guide coverage.
The state-attestation-evidence move uses the [operator-attested] tag, which is never documented in the guide, leaving coached authors unable to find the technique.

A new 'Responding to coaching moves' section in writing-a-passing-plan.md should document the top five moves with technique descriptions and before/after examples, keyed by move name in frequency order.
Move names in the guide must match the MOVE_REGISTRY spellings exactly and be validated by unit tests.
